name: Compare table
oneLiner: a glass comparison board stands up off a lit floor, ticks and crosses drop in row by row while each column's tally counts up and the camera leans down the rows; the brand column lifts out of the board, floods with the accent and its full tally rings out
say: when the speaker compares options feature by feature ('the others are fast or cheap, this does all four'): cut in on the comparison, the brand column lifts on the word that says it does everything
